Review result: ready to merge. The maintainer merges this fork PR by hand.

What we checked. We merged the head into current main in a review worktree. The merge is clean. We built and tested that tree, debug, one build: `camcraft-ui` lib 1234 pass, 0 fail; `egui_app` binary 8 pass (the four new tests pin rc 0, rc 2 and rc 1); `shell` binary 21 pass; `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` is clean.

Design check. The headless path reuses `launch_file::command` and `cli_options::files`, so the same check and the same commands run as in the window (#2462). A refused argument exits 2 before any adapter is touched. A file that does not import exits 1 and names the file. The seed proof stays for a `--headless` run with no file, and its Contour1 check still fails the run on zero moves. No new panic path: no unwrap or expect outside tests and `map_or_else` fallbacks.

Notes, not blockers. The project-open check reads the status text `opened `; a wording change in that status would need the test updated. The 5% pixel law is off for an opened document with no part facets; the decision file records this choice. The author's note about the `diag_lines_are_tracing_events_at_their_level` flake: that test passed in our run. This change is headless CLI, so no before/after screenshots apply; the readback line and the exit-code tests are the evidence.

Verdict: no blockers. Label set to merge-ready; the maintainer approves and merges by hand.

Merge class: SAME. The reviewed head is the merged head, `6c6bd83575fbd61ac4134f95d4f7006e13cfd661`. No commit came after it.

This merge relies on the built review by SlaveSession of 07:24 UTC on that head. The author is not a collaborator. The maintainer ordered this merge; the main session relayed the order.
